english.meaning: the time of two on the clock
english.note: 兩點幾 means a bit past two.

exampleSentences.english: It’s pretty tough—I don’t leave until one or two. I need to publish three papers and send them out.
exampleSentences.traditional: 因為都幾辛苦喇，一點至兩點先走啊。要發到三份嘅論文，班三份嘅論文出去囖。

exampleSentences.english: Wow, it’s late—I didn’t go to bed until after two last night.
exampleSentences.traditional: 嘩！噉𠻺夜囖，至夜琴晚兩點幾先瞓。
